elements.name: young man seen from behind in centre foreground
river of white and red car lights
many blue and white minibus taxis
thick crowd of people as soft dark shapes on both pavements
tall concrete and glass buildings with hundreds of lit windows

notes: Traffic and crowd are far too sparse: there is only one blue-and-white minibus and one car, and a few scattered pedestrians, so fill the avenue with a dense stream of white and red car lights, many minibus taxis and thick crowds on both pavements.
